title: 上海高考翻译背诵-67-25一模

items.zh: 随着技术革新,人人都能拍一段视频上传到平台。
items.en: With technological innovation, everyone can shoot a video and upload it to platforms.

items.zh: 在当前乃至未来很长一段时间,人工智能并非无所不能。
items.en: For now or even a long time to come, AI is far from a universal solution to all problems.

items.zh: 这位外国记者说,作为一个曾长期在沪居住的外国人,回到上海就有到家的感觉。
items.en: The foreign reporter said that as a foreigner who once lived in Shanghai for a log time, he feels at home the moment he returns.

items.zh: 她将中国深厚的传统文化同西方古典音乐的作曲与演奏技法融为一体,赋予音乐全新的生命和表现力。
items.en: She combines the profound traditional culture of China with the composition and performance techniques of Western classical music, giving music an entirely new life and expressive power.
